# dsh-stream-index-guard
Runtime guard for the DSH LLM assistant stream.
Some upstream LLM relays occasionally emit `text-delta` / `reasoning-delta` / `tool-call-delta` chun
ks with an invalid `index`. Left alone, one bad chunk hard-fails the whole turn (stuck session, trun
alid `index`. Left alone, one bad chunk hard-fails the whole turn (stuck session, truncated output).
This plugin patches `AssistantStreamAccumulator.push` at runtime and clamps an illegal index to the
last valid index (or 0), downgrading the hard failure into dropping/merging the bad chunk. It ships
a stats tool and on-disk state.
## How it works
- On apply it discovers the host's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` module files (derived from the host entry
script path, so it patches the exact loaded instances), and is idempotent via `Symbol.for('dsh-strea

m-index-guard')`.
- Override discovery with `DSH_STREAM_GUARD_TARGETS` — comma-separated `file://` U

RLs of the dsh-llm modules to patch.
- Registers the `stream_index_guard_stats` tool (patch targets,

clamped-chunk count, samples).
- Writes stats to `/tmp/dsh-stream-index-guard/stats.json`.
